messages:
oliver: During a routine RBAC audit I spotted an external service account bound to our KMS envelope key for partner-A (roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter). DM'd the relevant audit log to @nina and uploaded a redacted snapshot to the incident folder.

sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-046 created; evidence archived at s3://redwood-secure/incidents/SEC-2026-046 (immutable snapshot).

nina: Priority: 1) contain (pause partner ingestion), 2) remove external KMS binding, 3) snapshot tfstate/artifacts referencing that key, 4) plan rekey + rewrap. @ops-oncall please pause partner-a ingestion.

ops-oncall: Pausing now: `kubectl -n ingest scale deploy/partner-a-ingest --replicas=0` -> scaled at 11:07 UTC.

vault-admin: Auditing KMS policy: found binding `serviceAccount:partner-a@external`. Removing binding: `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/rdw/locations/global/keyRings/partners/cryptoKeys/envelope-partner-a --member='serviceAccount:partner-a@external' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'`. Applying change and snapshotting policy to incident folder.

oliver: Also discovered two tfstate snapshots and one backup blob that reference the wrapped ciphertext. Plan: create new envelope key `envelope-partner-a-v2`, update internal rewrap-runner, and perform rewrap-on-read with background rewrap job to rotate stored ciphertexts. Owner: vault-admin.

legal-ana: Looping in legal for vendor access implications. Preserve chain-of-custody and extend log retention to 90d for this case.

nina: Owners & timeline: immediate containment (0-30m) = ops + vault-admin; RBAC removal & evidence (0-1h) = vault-admin; rekey & rewrap (1-4h) = vault-admin/oliver; rollout & validate (4-6h) = ops; postmortem & vendor policy update (24-72h) = nina + legal-ana.

sec-bot: Incident status -> containment in progress. Evidence frozen and versioned. Please post all updates to this thread.
